svg.text: Evaluation arm: selection and scoring inside each held-out-lineage fold
Deployment arm: selection refit on all data
Gate: nothing downstream starts until it passes
Stations run once per drug; per-fold stations run once per held-out lineage (4 folds). Open markers are optional steps.
